params.body:
The three steps on Bespreken were stacked in one block: every relation first, then the projects and the people far below it.

- Te bespreken now has a tab per step: Relaties, Projecten, Mensen, each with "x van y besproken" under its name. Tabs are text with an underline on the open one.
- The page opens on the first step with something left to do; the open tab is kept in the link as `?stap=relaties|projecten|mensen`.
- "Nog te doen / Alles" and the overall progress stay above the tabs.
- Saving the last open item of a tab opens the next item in the following tab and switches to it.
- The list of everything told, with its filters, stays below.

Tests: 338 pass, pint clean. HandoverAgendaTest covers opening a tab and moving on to the next one; NetworkTest checks the tabs render. Checked in the browser at 1280 and 390 wide.
